title: Workflow definitions (one file per workflow under standards/workflows/, merged on load)

event_kinds.description: Event kinds this workflow's steps complete on; every done_when.kind must be listed, and each must be in the event schema's kind enum (checked by validate)

subject.description: candidate, assignment and exercise are child subjects opened by a `subject` event (event@3, decision 0011); cycle, sample, bench and override are child subjects too (subject@2, decision 0014), and appeal (decision 0021). All added to workflows@1 as backward-compatible minor changes.

applies_to.description: Filter on the instructor's type, baseline level and registration jurisdiction (all must match when given). On a jurisdiction subject the jurisdiction filter matches the subject's own code.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166 codes as the roster writes them (IE, US-CA), matched exactly against the registration

needs_except_opened_by.description: Maps a step id from `needs` to the steps whose `subject` event may have opened a child subject (its `opened_by`): for a child opened by one of them the need is waived, because that step stands in for it (an ad-hoc assignment's own approval stands in for the batch approval). Only child subjects; checked by validate. Added to workflows@1 as a backward-compatible minor change (decision 0015).

match.description: Payload fields that must equal these values. One template form is resolved: the string value ${subject.notice_variant} stands for the notice variant the subject (an instructor) is owed, so "notice sent" matches the right variant per instructor; a subject with no notice variant matches nothing. Added to workflows@1 as a backward-compatible minor change (decision 0009).

skippable.description: With bind: input. A system `step` event {step: <id>, skipped: true, input_sha256: <hash>} also completes the step while its hash equals the hash of the step's current inputs, for a human step that does not apply to a subject (for example a DPIA delta that is empty). Validate refuses it without bind: input. Added to workflows@1 as a backward-compatible minor change (decision 0009).

revocable.description: With bind: input. A holder of the step's role may withdraw the approval in force with a sign-off of decision revoke on a page `teachermodel revoke-page` writes; the step is then open again until a new approval. Only for steps whose approval has no sign-off hook and no fixed signers (checked by validate). Added to workflows@1 as a backward-compatible minor change (decision 0019).

bind.description: input: done only while the newest approving sign-off's input_sha256 equals the hash of the step's current inputs, so a change to the inputs reopens it. Only for kind signoff (checked by validate). Added to workflows@1 as a backward-compatible minor change (decision 0009).

due.description: A rule name in teachermodel.rules, or a number of days labelled operational default

signer.description: Human step on a child subject: who may sign, read from the subject's attrs (the assigned observer, the instructor observed, or any one of an exercise's observers who has not yet signed). The signer must also hold the step's role. Added to workflows@1 as a backward-compatible minor change (decision 0012).

basis.description: Spec section, decision id, or 'operational default' (decision 0002)
